question: Can adding to an actual profitable V1.7 reclaim position after an independent, same-direction 12H Monday-band breakout increase account growth?
single_variable: Enable one additional separately funded native breakout per currently held profitable original reclaim. No addition unless the original reclaim was actually funded earlier, is open on the breakout confirmation clock, the breakout direction agrees, and closing the original at that 12H close would give positive PnL after taker entry and exit fees.
timing: Use the native 12H close of the signal candle. All currently held positions occupy their slot through the whole exit hour as in the reference account. At equal clocks, process original reclaim signals first with the original CRC ordering, followed by add requests in CRC order. An original already closed at that open is ineligible. Allow a maximum of one add per original across its life. An add uses the independently confirmed breakout's stop and native exit. A new original cannot enter while either position remains open.
account: One 1000 USDT VectorBT cash account with nine fully collateralized equal slots, unchanged fee of 5bp per fill; separate additional 5bp slippage stress. No transferred or invented collateral. Compare against the frozen 360-name reclaim account. Show funded leg statistics and parent-group monetary payoff. No historical funding.
